questions.question: What parable does Ezekiel 17 tell?
options: Two great eagles and a vine
Two baskets of figs, good and bad
A boiling pot tipped from the north
A potter shaping clay on his wheel
questions.answer: Two great eagles and a vine

questions.question: What did the parable signify?
options: The long-awaited return of the exiles from their captivity
Zedekiah's rebellion against Babylon by turning to Egypt
The coming of a righteous king from the line of David
The fall of mighty Assyria before the rising Babylonians
questions.answer: Zedekiah's rebellion against Babylon by turning to Egypt

questions.question: At the end of chapter 17 God promises to plant a tender sprig that becomes a noble cedar.
Ezekiel was told to propound a riddle and speak a _____ to the house of Israel.
God would take a sprig from the lofty top of the _____ and plant it on a high mountain.
